Package net.maswag.falcaun.oracle

Class RobustnessOracle

java.lang.Object
net.maswag.falcaun.oracle.RobustnessOracle
All Implemented Interfaces:
EvaluationCountable
public class RobustnessOracle extends Object implements EvaluationCountable
Answers membership queries together with the robustness value for a cost function.

The SUL is executed by the NumericMembershipOracle that created this oracle. This oracle owns only the robustness cache for its cost function, which maps an abstract input word to the robustness values of its prefixes. The cache is filled by the executions requested by this oracle or by the oracles registered before it.
